js: (function(){const G = window.__game; G.App.start(); G.save.set.dev = true; return G.App.mode;})()

(function(){const G = window.__game, C = G.Col; const it = C.items[0]; G.Foot.exit(); G.Foot.on = true; G.Foot.x = it.ox + 6; G.Foot.z = it.oz + 6; G.Foot.y = 40; G.Foot.state = 'walk'; G.loadAround(it.ox, it.oz, 40); return it.id;})()

(function(){const G = window.__game, C = G.Col; const it = C.items[0]; const r = { id: it.id, ok: it.ok, moved: Math.round(Math.hypot(it.x - it.ox, it.z - it.oz)), blocked: G.footBlockedAt(it.x, it.z), y: Math.round(it.y) }; const m0 = G.save.money; G.Foot.x = it.x + 1; G.Foot.z = it.z; G.Foot.y = it.y; G.Pl.x = G.Foot.x; G.Pl.z = G.Foot.z; G.Pl.y = G.Foot.y; C.update(0.016, 1); r.got = !!G.save.col.got[it.id]; r.dm = G.save.money - m0; return JSON.stringify(r);})()
